method: Deduplicate prompt IDs; freeze source & SHA; n200 dev/n>=500 final where possible, alternate seeds.

literature_checks.claim: The Parallel Loop Transformer evaluates different loop iterations for different tokens concurrently (shared first-loop KV plus gated sliding-window attention), reportedly matching looped accuracy with little added latency/memory over a non-looped model.
literature_checks.transfer_caveat: It changes which token states are available at each depth and is trained with that architecture (shared first-loop KV is not a drop-in policy for existing Huginn/Ouro checkpoints), and FLOPs still grow with loop count.
